description: This file defines the 'Cron' class within the Opencart admin model setting namespace. It manages cron jobs by providing methods for adding, deleting, editing, and retrieving cron job details, and interacts with the database to perform CRUD operations on a 'cron' table.

classes.name: Cron
classes.description: Represents cron job management functions within the OpenCart admin setting namespace.

methods.name: addCron
methods.description: Inserts a new cron job record into the database with specified code, description, cycle, action, and status.

methods.name: deleteCron
methods.description: Deletes a cron job from the database based on its ID.

methods.name: deleteCronByCode
methods.description: Deletes a cron job from the database based on its code.

methods.name: editCron
methods.description: Updates the modification date of a specific cron job by its ID.

methods.name: editStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of a specific cron job by its ID.

methods.name: getCron
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific cron job by its ID.

methods.name: getCronByCode
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific cron job by its code.

methods.name: getCrons
methods.description: Retrieves a list of cron jobs, optionally sorted and paginated.

methods.name: getTotalCrons
methods.description: Returns the total number of cron jobs in the database.
